paragraphs: Many people in Ireland listen to the radio every day. A new survey shows the most popular shows.
RTÉ Radio 1's Morning Ireland is number one. About 464,000 people listen to it each day. That is 7,000 more than last year.
Today with David McCullagh is number two. It has 421,000 listeners. Liveline also got more listeners this year.
RTÉ has all of the top ten shows. Newstalk is another radio station. It also has more listeners now.
Claire Byrne's show on Newstalk has 222,000 listeners. That is 12,000 more than before. The breakfast show on RTÉ 2FM also grew. It now has 189,000 listeners.
sentZh: 愛爾蘭有很多人每天聽廣播。
一項新調查顯示了最受歡迎的節目。
RTÉ第一台的《Morning Ireland》排名第一。
每天大約有46.4萬人收聽。
這比去年多了7,000人。
《Today with David McCullagh》排名第二。
它有42.1萬名聽眾。
《Liveline》今年的聽眾也增加了。
RTÉ擁有前十名的全部節目。
Newstalk是另一個廣播電台。
它現在的聽眾也變多了。
Newstalk上克萊兒·伯恩的節目有22.2萬名聽眾。
這比之前多了1.2萬人。
RTÉ 2FM的早晨節目也成長了。
它現在有18.9萬名聽眾。

paragraphs: Morning Ireland on RTÉ Radio 1 is still the most popular radio programme in Ireland, according to new listening figures.

The figures come from a survey of 16,750 people over the 12 months to September 2026. Morning Ireland has an average of 464,000 listeners every day, up 7,000 on last year. Today with David McCullagh is in second place with 421,000, and Oliver Callan's show has 283,000.
Liveline had one of the biggest increases, going up from 254,000 to 268,000 listeners. On the other hand, Drivetime lost 9,000 listeners and now has 202,000.
On RTÉ 2FM, the breakfast show with Carl Mullan, Roz Purcell and Aisling Bonner gained 14,000 listeners and now has 189,000. On Newstalk, Claire Byrne's show grew by 12,000 to 222,000.
RTÉ has all of the top 10 programmes and 15 of the top 20. Its main competitor, Newstalk, also did well. Its share of listeners rose to 8.3%, and The Hard Shoulder gained 17,000 listeners.
sentZh: 根據新的收聽數據，RTÉ第一台的《Morning Ireland》仍是愛爾蘭最受歡迎的廣播節目。
這些數據來自截至2026年9月的12個月內對16,750人所做的調查。
《Morning Ireland》平均每天有46.4萬名聽眾，比去年多了7,000人。
《Today with David McCullagh》以42.1萬人排名第二，奧利佛·卡倫的節目則有28.3萬人。
《Liveline》是增幅最大的節目之一，聽眾從25.4萬增加到26.8萬。
另一方面，《Drivetime》流失了9,000名聽眾，現在有20.2萬人。
在RTÉ 2FM，由卡爾·穆蘭、蘿茲·珀塞爾和艾絲琳·邦納主持的早晨節目增加了1.4萬名聽眾，現在有18.9萬人。
在Newstalk，克萊兒·伯恩的節目增加了1.2萬人，達到22.2萬人。
RTÉ擁有前10名的全部節目，以及前20名中的15個。
它的主要競爭對手Newstalk也表現不錯。
其聽眾占比升至8.3%，《The Hard Shoulder》增加了1.7萬名聽眾。

paragraphs: RTÉ Radio 1's Morning Ireland remains the country's most listened-to radio programme, according to the latest JNLR survey, which is based on 16,750 interviews over the 12 months to September 2026.

The breakfast news show attracts an average of 464,000 daily listeners, an increase of 7,000. Today with David McCullagh holds second place with 421,000, down slightly by 1,000, while Oliver Callan's late-morning slot draws 283,000.

Liveline recorded one of the strongest gains, rising from 254,000 to 268,000, whereas Drivetime slipped by 9,000 to 202,000. Over the weekend, Brendan O'Connor's Saturday show added 11,000 listeners to reach 411,000.

Elsewhere, RTÉ 2FM's breakfast show, presented by Carl Mullan, Roz Purcell and Aisling Bonner, gained 14,000 listeners to reach 189,000, while Claire Byrne's programme on Newstalk climbed by 12,000 to 222,000.

Overall, RTÉ dominates the rankings, holding the entire top 10 and 15 of the top 20 programmes. However, rival station Newstalk also had reason to celebrate: its market share rose to 8.3%, and The Hard Shoulder gained 17,000 listeners.
sentZh: 根據最新的JNLR調查（基於截至2026年9月的12個月內16,750次訪談），RTÉ第一台的《Morning Ireland》仍是全國收聽率最高的廣播節目。
這個早晨新聞節目平均每天吸引46.4萬名聽眾，增加了7,000人。
《Today with David McCullagh》以42.1萬人保持第二，小幅減少1,000人，而奧利佛·卡倫的上午稍晚時段則吸引28.3萬人。
《Liveline》錄得最強勁的增長之一，從25.4萬升至26.8萬，而《Drivetime》則下滑9,000人，至20.2萬人。
在週末，布倫丹·奧康納的週六節目增加了1.1萬名聽眾，達到41.1萬人。
此外，由卡爾·穆蘭、蘿茲·珀塞爾和艾絲琳·邦納主持的RTÉ 2FM早晨節目增加1.4萬名聽眾，達到18.9萬人，而克萊兒·伯恩在Newstalk的節目則增加1.2萬人，達到22.2萬人。
整體而言，RTÉ主宰排行榜，囊括前10名全部節目以及前20名中的15個。
然而，競爭對手Newstalk也有理由慶祝：其市占率升至8.3%，《The Hard Shoulder》增加了1.7萬名聽眾。

paragraphs: Morning Ireland on RTÉ Radio 1 has retained its crown as the nation's most popular radio programme, according to the latest JNLR survey, compiled from 16,750 interviews over the year to September 2026.

The flagship breakfast show now commands an average daily audience of 464,000, a rise of 7,000. Today with David McCullagh holds firm in second place on 421,000, a negligible dip of 1,000, while Oliver Callan's late-morning slot draws 283,000.

Liveline posted one of the most notable gains, climbing from 254,000 to 268,000, whereas Drivetime shed 9,000 listeners to settle at 202,000. At the weekend, Brendan O'Connor's Saturday programme added 11,000 to reach 411,000.

Further down the dial, RTÉ 2FM's breakfast team of Carl Mullan, Roz Purcell and Aisling Bonner won over an additional 14,000 listeners, taking their tally to 189,000, while Claire Byrne's Newstalk programme climbed by 12,000 to 222,000.

RTÉ's dominance is unmistakable: it occupies the entire top 10 and 15 of the top 20 slots. Nonetheless, rival broadcaster Newstalk has grounds for optimism, having nudged its market share up to 8.3%, with The Hard Shoulder gaining a healthy 17,000 listeners.
sentZh: 根據最新的JNLR調查（彙整截至2026年9月一年內的16,750次訪談），RTÉ第一台的《Morning Ireland》保住了全國最受歡迎廣播節目的寶座。
這個招牌早晨節目目前平均每日擁有46.4萬名聽眾，增加了7,000人。
《Today with David McCullagh》以42.1萬人穩居第二，僅微幅下降1,000人，而奧利佛·卡倫的上午稍晚時段則吸引28.3萬人。
《Liveline》錄得最顯著的增長之一，從25.4萬攀升至26.8萬，而《Drivetime》則流失9,000名聽眾，降至20.2萬人。
在週末，布倫丹·奧康納的週六節目增加了1.1萬人，達到41.1萬人。
在其他電台方面，RTÉ 2FM由卡爾·穆蘭、蘿茲·珀塞爾和艾絲琳·邦納組成的早晨團隊多爭取到1.4萬名聽眾，總數達18.9萬人，而克萊兒·伯恩的Newstalk節目則增加1.2萬人，達到22.2萬人。
RTÉ的主導地位明確無誤：它佔據前10名全部以及前20名中的15席。
儘管如此，競爭對手Newstalk也有樂觀的理由，其市占率小幅升至8.3%，《The Hard Shoulder》更增加了可觀的1.7萬名聽眾。

paragraphs: According to the most recent JNLR survey, which comprised 16,750 interviews conducted over the twelve months to September 2026, RTÉ Radio 1's Morning Ireland continues to be the most widely listened-to radio programme in Ireland.

The programme attracts an average of 464,000 listeners per day, representing an increase of 7,000. Today with David McCullagh remains in second position with 421,000, a marginal decline of 1,000, while Oliver Callan's late-morning programme has an audience of 283,000.

Liveline experienced one of the most substantial increases, rising from 254,000 to 268,000. Conversely, Drivetime declined by 9,000 to 202,000. Brendan O'Connor's Saturday programme also grew considerably, by 11,000, to 411,000.

Furthermore, RTÉ 2FM's breakfast programme, presented by Carl Mullan, Roz Purcell and Aisling Bonner, gained 14,000 listeners, reaching 189,000, whereas Claire Byrne's programme on Newstalk increased by 12,000 to 222,000.

Consequently, RTÉ maintains a dominant position, accounting for the entire top 10 and 15 of the top 20 programmes. Nevertheless, its principal competitor, Newstalk, also performed well, increasing its market share to 8.3%, while The Hard Shoulder gained 17,000 listeners.
sentZh: 根據最新的JNLR調查（包含截至2026年9月的十二個月內進行的16,750次訪談），RTÉ第一台的《Morning Ireland》仍是愛爾蘭收聽最廣泛的廣播節目。
該節目平均每天吸引46.4萬名聽眾，代表增加了7,000人。
《Today with David McCullagh》以42.1萬人保持第二名，僅微幅下降1,000人，而奧利佛·卡倫的上午稍晚節目則有28.3萬名聽眾。
《Liveline》是增幅最大的節目之一，從25.4萬升至26.8萬。
相反地，《Drivetime》下降9,000人，至20.2萬人。
布倫丹·奧康納的週六節目也大幅成長1.1萬人，達到41.1萬人。
此外，由卡爾·穆蘭、蘿茲·珀塞爾和艾絲琳·邦納主持的RTÉ 2FM早晨節目增加1.4萬名聽眾，達到18.9萬人，而克萊兒·伯恩在Newstalk的節目則增加1.2萬人，達到22.2萬人。
因此，RTÉ保持主導地位，囊括前10名全部節目以及前20名中的15個。
然而，其主要競爭對手Newstalk也表現良好，市占率提升至8.3%，而《The Hard Shoulder》增加了1.7萬名聽眾。

paragraphs: RTÉ Radio 1's Morning Ireland remains the country's most listened-to radio programme, according to the latest JNLR survey, which is based on 16,750 interviews over the 12 months to September 2026.

The breakfast news show attracts an average of 464,000 daily listeners, an increase of 7,000. Today with David McCullagh holds second place with 421,000, down slightly by 1,000, while Oliver Callan's late-morning slot draws 283,000.

Liveline recorded one of the strongest gains, rising from 254,000 to 268,000, whereas Drivetime slipped by 9,000 to 202,000. Over the weekend, Brendan O'Connor's Saturday show added 11,000 listeners to reach 411,000.

Elsewhere, RTÉ 2FM's breakfast show, presented by Carl Mullan, Roz Purcell and Aisling Bonner, gained 14,000 listeners to reach 189,000, while Claire Byrne's programme on Newstalk climbed by 12,000 to 222,000.

Overall, RTÉ dominates the rankings, holding the entire top 10 and 15 of the top 20 programmes. However, rival station Newstalk also had reason to celebrate: its market share rose to 8.3%, and The Hard Shoulder gained 17,000 listeners.
